SELECT CAST(g.tag_group_id AS CHAR) AS tagGroupId, g.name AS tagGroupName, GROUP_CONCAT(t.tag_name ORDER BY t.sort_no ASC, t.tag_id ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS tagNamesCsv, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS memberCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rel.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN c.customer_id ELSE NULL END) AS recentlyAddedCount, 'system' AS createdBy, DATE_FORMAT(g.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(g.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, COALESCE(g.source_type, 'manual') AS source, CASE WHEN COALESCE(g.source_type, 'manual') = 'wechat' THEN 'syncing' ELSE 'enabled' END AS status, CONCAT('tags:', COUNT(DISTINCT t.tag_id), ', members:', COUNT(DISTINCT rel.customer_id)) AS description FROM crm_customer_tag_group g LEFT JOIN crm_customer_tag t ON t.tag_group_id = g.tag_group_id AND t.status = 1 LEFT JOIN crm_customer_tag_rel rel ON rel.tag_id = t.tag_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = rel.customer_id AND c.camp_id = g.camp_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE g.camp_id = #{campId} AND g.status = 1
AND ( g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer_tag kt WHERE kt.tag_group_id = g.tag_group_id AND kt.status = 1 AND kt.tag_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) )
GROUP BY g.tag_group_id, g.name, g.source_type, g.sort_no, g.created_at, g.updated_at ORDER BY g.sort_no ASC, g.tag_group_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_tag_group ( tag_group_id, camp_id, name, source_type, sort_no, status ) VALUES ( #{tagGroupId}, #{campId}, #{tagGroupName}, #{sourceType}, 0, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), source_type = VALUES(source_type), status = 1, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO crm_customer_tag ( tag_id, tag_group_id, tag_name, sort_no, status ) VALUES ( #{tagId}, #{tagGroupId}, #{tagName}, #{sortNo}, 1 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(member_id AS CHAR) AS accountId, name AS accountName, wecom_user_id AS wecomUserId, mobile AS mobile, CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'disabled' END AS status, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM pms_member WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND wecom_user_id IS NOT NULL AND wecom_user_id != '' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, member_id ASC
